description: Cosiplan Portos is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Camada relativa ao portos em operação no Brasil. Esta camada é subsídio para as atividades do Conselho Sulamericano de Infraestrutura e Planejamento (Cosiplan). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Cosiplan, Portos, planningCadastre. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
